sources.title: Multi-Modal Generative AI: Multi-modal LLM, Diffusion and Beyond
sources.snippet: To serve both generation and understanding objectives, i) should we just employ Mixture of Experts (MoE) strategies, ii) or only use a dense model? To answer these questions, in this paper, we focus on problems regarding the visual/video-language modalities, presenting a deep and comprehensive discussion of multi-modal generative AI.

sources.title: Introduction to Multimodal Generative AI | Springer Nature Link
sources.snippet: A state-of-the-art method in machine learning is called Multimodal Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI), which aims to produce a variety of outputs in many modalities, including text, audio, and images. sources.title: Multimodal RAG Survey
sources.snippet: This survey offers a structured and comprehensive analysis of Multimodal RAG systems, covering datasets, metrics, benchmarks, evaluation, methodologies, and innovations in retrieval, fusion, augmentation, and generation.
